definitions.explanation: The amount or proportion of sugar contained in food or drink. Also used loosely to refer to sugar or sweets in general, especially when talking about dietary intake.

examples.japanese: {糖分|とうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{糖分|とうぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This drink has a lot of sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{糖分|とうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you're tired, taking in some sugar clears your head.

notes:
Compound of {糖|とう} (sugar) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (portion, content). Refers to sugar content in food and drink, or sugar intake in a dietary context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糖分|とうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧: to cut back on sugar
- {糖分|とうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ / ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to consume sugar
- {糖分|とうぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ / ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: high/low in sugar
- {糖分|とうぶん}⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧: sugar replenishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: sugar (the physical substance)
- ⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧: carbohydrates/sugars (nutrition label term)
- {糖分|とうぶん}: sugar content (more general, dietary context)
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの: sweets, sweet things (casual)

Phrases like ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{糖分|とうぶん}⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧ ("I'm tired, time for some sugar") are common in everyday conversation as a light justification for eating sweets.
